intent: Test whether <*>_x / relation-mediated continuation is load-bearing, or whether observed persistence is explainable by generic state update, density, topology, smoothing, or attractor dynamics.

target_claim.plain: Stable identity-like closure requires relation-mediated continuation, not specific triads, nodes, or orientation objects.

null_hypothesis.formal: K_obs persists when <*>_x is removed, randomized, memoryless, or replaced by generic adjacency.
null_hypothesis.plain: The relation operator is not load-bearing; stable structures arise from ordinary coupling or attractor dynamics.

required_observables.B_boundary: fraction_of updates mediated through explicit relation boundary
required_observables.X_noncollapse: degree of preserved non-identity under coupling

ablations.change: Remove <*>_x entirely; allow only local state updates.
ablations.falsifies_if: I_persist and S_closure match M0 within tau

ablations.change: Replace <*>_x with random pairwise coupling preserving degree distribution.
ablations.falsifies_if: R_link and I_persist match M0 within tau

ablations.change: Allow relation coupling but remove residue/history dependence.
Replace relational correspondence with generic graph adjacency.
ablations.falsifies_if: K_detect and transport continuity match M0

ablations.change: Permit copying of state signatures without relational boundary preservation.
ablations.falsifies_if: I_persist remains high despite X_noncollapse failure

ablations.change: Preserve topology/connectivity but scramble relational labels and histories.
Match local coupling density while destroying relation-specific correspondence.
ablations.falsifies_if: M7 reproduces M0 closure and transport

ablations.change: Allow direct object-to-object update without D(*|*) boundary mediation.
Preserve only (ℰ≠0) and δ_a while removing structured relation semantics.

primary_tests.name: state_replacement_identity_test
primary_tests.purpose: Determine whether identity persists through replacement only when relational correspondence is preserved.
primary_tests.pass_for_framework: M0 maintains I_persist while M1/M2/M3 fail.

primary_tests.name: transport_handoff_test
primary_tests.purpose: Determine whether closure handoff requires <*>_x rather than adjacency.

primary_tests.name: noncollapse_test
primary_tests.purpose: Determine whether relation-mediated coupling preserves distinction instead of collapsing into identity or noise.
primary_tests.pass_for_framework: X_noncollapse remains high only in M0.

primary_tests.name: topology_spoof_test
primary_tests.purpose: Determine whether topology alone explains closure.

success_condition_for_framework.plain: <*>_x survives only if relation-specific correspondence predicts identity persistence better than density, topology, random coupling, or memoryless adjacency.
success_condition_for_framework.formal: I_persist(M0) - I_persist(Mi) >= tau for M1,M2,M3,M4,M6,M7,M8 in at least three mechanism classes

failure_condition_for_framework.plain: If stable identity-like closure survives without relation semantics, <*>_x is not load-bearing.
failure_condition_for_framework.formal: exists Mi in {M1,M2,M3,M4,M6,M7,M8,M9} such that abs(I_persist(M0)-I_persist(Mi)) < tau

hard_fail_conditions: Results fail to reproduce across at least three mechanism classes
